# Catalogue Operation table descriptions

Listed bellow the are POWERCARD tables involved the catalogue operations.

represents the primary key of the table.


## CATALOGUE_STATUS_TRAIL

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to manage the status trail generation for 'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.


## Columns description

|   Seq. | Column Name            | Data  Type Len.   | Column Description                                                                                                                       |
|--------|------------------------|-------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|      1 | BANK_CODE CHAR         | 6                 | The Issuer Financial institution for which the parameters are being defined. This bank code should  already be declared in 'BANK' table. |
|      2 | PRODUCT_CODE           | CHAR 6            | The catalog product code for which the status has been changed. It should already be declared in  'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.             |
|      3 | PROD_VERSION VARCHA R2 | 10                | The catalog product version for which the status has been changed. It should be already be declared in  'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.       |
|      4 | SOURCE_STATUS          | CHAR 1            | The old catalog status.                                                                                                                  |
|      5 | DESTINATION_ST ATUS    | CHAR 1            | The new catalog status.                                                                                                                  |
|      6 | ACTION_USER VARCHA R2  | 15                | The user that has performed the catalog status change.                                                                                   |
|      7 | ACTION_DATE            | DATE 7            | The date the catalog status has changed.                                                                                                 |

|      7 | ACTION_DATE            | DATE 7            | The date the catalog status has changed.                                                                                                 |
|      8 | MEMO                   | VARCHA 512        | The memo written during the execution of the change of status.                                                                           |
|      9 | USER_CREATE            | VARCHA 15         | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                      |
|     10 | DATE_CREATE            | DATE 7            | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                           |
|     11 | USER_MODIF             | VARCHA 15         | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                             |
|     12 | DATE_MODIF             | DATE 7            | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                                |

## CATALOGUE_TRACES

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to manage the traces generated during the validation of marketable catalog products.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.

Columns description


|   Seq. | Column Name   | Data  Type   |   Len. | Sc.   | Column Description                                                                                                                       |
|--------|---------------|--------------|--------|-------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|      1 | SEQUENCE_ID   | NUMBER       |     10 |       | The sequence identifying the trace.                                                                                                      |
|      2 | TRACE_DATE    | DATE         |      7 |       | The date when the trace is logged.                                                                                                       |
|      3 | BANK_CODE     | CHAR         |      6 |       | The issuer financial institution for which the parameters are being defined. This bank code should  already be declared in 'BANK' table. |

|   4 | PRODUCT_CODE             | CHAR      |   6 | The catalog product code. This product code should be already declared in  'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.                                                                                                    |
|-----|--------------------------|-----------|-----|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   5 | PRODUCT_TYPE             | CHAR      |   1 | The catalog product type. Possible values are: 'P' = Payment instrument, 'A' = Account, 'N' = Loan, 'Y' = Loyalty, 'I' = PAN auxiliary product, 'C' = Account auxiliary product, 'R' = Product services, |
|   6 | PRODUCT_VERSION          | VARCHA R2 |   3 | The catalog product version. It should be already declared in 'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.                                                                                                                 |
|   7 | APPLICATION_ID           | VARCHA R2 |  24 | The application ID in case this trace is related to an error in negotiation process when validating an  application from boarding screens.                                                               |
|   8 | APPLICATION_CONTR ACT_ID | VARCHA R2 |  24 | The contract ID in case this trace is related to an error in negotiation process when validating an  application from boarding screens.                                                                  |

|   8 | APPLICATION_CONTR ACT_ID | VARCHA R2 |  24 | The contract ID in case this trace is related to an error in negotiation process when validating an  application from boarding screens.                                                                  |
|   9 | ENTITY_NAME              | VARCHA R2 |  60 | The name of the entity for which we are putting a trace.                                                                                                                                                 |
|  10 | TRACE_TYPE               | VARCHA R2 |  30 | The type of the trace. Possible values are: 'INFO' = Info, 'WARNING' = Warning, 'ERROR' = Error.                                                                                                         |
|  11 | ERROR_CODE               | CHAR      |   4 | The error code in case the trace is of type error.                                                                                                                                                       |
|  12 | TRACE_MESSAGE            | VARCHA R2 | 512 | The message that can be an information, warning or error description.                                                                                                                                    |
|  13 | USER_CREATE              | VARCHA R2 |  15 | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                                                                                      |
|  14 | DATE_CREATE              | DATE      |   7 | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                           |
|  15 | USER_MODIF               | VARCHA R2 |  15 | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                                                                                             |

|  15 | USER_MODIF               | VARCHA R2 |  15 | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                                                                                             |
|  16 | DATE_MODIF               | DATE      |   7 | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                                                                                                |

# CATALOGUE_UPGRADE

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to manage the upgrade of existing catalogs in 'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.


## Columns description


|   Seq. | Column Name          | Data Type   |   Len. | Sc.   | Column Description                          |
|--------|----------------------|-------------|--------|-------|---------------------------------------------|
|      1 | CATALOGUE_UPGRADE_ID | NUMBER      |     10 |       | ID identifying the catalog upgrade request. |

|   2 | PRODUCT_TYPE              | CHAR     |   1 | The catalog product type. Possible values are: 'P' = Payment instrument, 'A' = Account, 'N' = Loan, 'Y' = Loyalty, 'I' = PAN auxiliary product, 'C' = Account auxiliary product, 'R' = Product services, 'S' = Payment instrument switch.   |
|-----|---------------------------|----------|-----|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   3 | DESCRIPTION               | VARCHAR2 | 512 | The description that defines details about the patch and impact if needed.                                                                                                                                                                  |
|   4 | UPGRADE_ISSUANCE_DATE     | DATE     |   7 | The patch creation date.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|   5 | INSTALLATION_STATUS       | CHAR     |   1 | The status of the upgrade execution. Possible values are: 'N' = Not yet installed, 'P' = Processed.                                                                                                                                         |
|   6 | UPGRADE_INSTALLATION_DATE | DATE     |   7 | The patch installation date on the destination environment.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|   7 | USER_CREATE               | VARCHAR2 |  15 | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|   8 | DATE_CREATE               | DATE     |   7 | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

|   8 | DATE_CREATE               | DATE     |   7 | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|   9 | USER_MODIF                | VARCHAR2 |  15 | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|  10 | DATE_MODIF                | DATE     |   7 | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                                                                                                                                   |

# CATALOGUE_UPGRADE_INSTRUCTION

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD, it contains the instructions related to a catalog upgrade patch.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.


## Columns description

|   Seq. | Column Name           | Data  Type   |   Len. | Sc.   | Column Description                                                                           |
|--------|-----------------------|--------------|--------|-------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|      1 | CATALOGUE_UPGRA DE_ID | NUMBER       |     10 |       | The unique number of the catalog upgrade. It should be defined in 'CATALOGUE_UPGRADE' table. |
|      2 | INSTRUCTION_ID        | NUMBER       |     10 |       | Unique ID of the different instructions part of a catalog product upgrade patch.             |
|      3 | DESCRIPTION           | VARCH AR2    |    128 |       | Description of the instruction and changes made.                                             |
|      4 | PARENT_ELEMENT_T YPE  | VARCH AR2    |    256 |       | The parent tag type of the element to be upgraded.                                           |
|      5 | PARENT_ELEMENT_P ATH  | VARCH AR2    |   2043 |       | The path  of the element to be upgraded.                                                     |
|      6 | PARENT_ELEMENT_ID     | VARCH AR2    |    512 |       | The tag id of the parent of the element to be upgraded.                                      |

|      6 | PARENT_ELEMENT_ID     | VARCH AR2    |    512 |       | The tag id of the parent of the element to be upgraded.                                      |
|      7 | ELEMENT_TYPE          | VARCH AR2    |    256 |       | The type of the element to be upgraded. It can be a characteristic, group data or attribute. |
|      8 | ELEMENT_ID            | VARCH AR2    |    512 |       | The tag ID of the element to be upgraded.                                                    |

|   9 | OPERATION                  | VARCH AR2   |   256 | The operation to be performed on this element. Possible values are: 'U' = Update, 'A' = Add, 'R' = Remove,                                                                                                                     |
|-----|----------------------------|-------------|-------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|  10 | IMPACTED_ATTRIBUTE         | VARCH AR2   |   512 | This column is used when the changes is made on an attribute. This column should be kept empty when the changes are made on characteristics or group data. Note:                                                               |
|  11 | ADDITION_ELEMENT_ POSITION | NUMBER      |     3 | When the operation is add, this column is used to specify the position where this element will be added  (order in the list of group Data or characteristics). If empty, the element will be added in the last position. Note: |
|  12 | VALUE                      | CLOB        |  4000 | The value of the added or updated element.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|  13 | APPLY_ON_ALL_OCC URENCES   | CHAR        |     1 | In case of the element to be upgraded has occurrences, this column indicates if the changes will be  applied on all occurrences or only the first one. Possible values are: 'Y' = Yes, 'N' = No.                               |

|  14 | DESTINATION_PATH           | VARCH AR2   |   512 | In case the OPERATION = 'M' (Move), this column indicates the destination path where the element  will be removed.                                                                                                             |
|  15 | DESTINATION_NEW_ID         | VARCH AR2   |   128 | In case the OPERATION = 'M' (Move), this column contains the new ID of the element to be removed. If empty the element will keep the same old ID. Note:                                                                        |
|  16 | USER_CREATE                | VARCH AR2   |    15 | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  17 | DATE_CREATE                | DATE        |     7 | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|  18 | USER_MODIF                 | VARCH AR2   |    15 | ID of the last user who modified the record.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|  19 | DATE_MODIF                 | DATE        |     7 | Date and time when the last record modification occurred.                                                                                                                                                                      |

# CATALOGUE_UPGRADE_TARGET_PRODS

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to define the list of catalog products for which the upgrade patch should be applied.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.


## Columns description

This table is an internal table used by  PowerCARD  to define the list of catalog products for which the upgrade patch should be applied.

Each column of this table is described in detail in the next section.


## Columns description


| Seq.                  | Column Name   |   Data  Type Len. | Column Description                                                                                                                  |
|-----------------------|---------------|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| CATALOGUE_UPGR ADE_ID | NUMBER        |                10 | The unique number identifying the upgrade. It should be defined in 'CATALOGUE_UPGRADE' table.                                       |
| 2 BANK_CODE           | CHAR          |                 6 | The issuer financial institution code. This institution code should already be declared in 'BANK' table.                            |
| PRODUCT_CODE          | VARCHA R2     |                 6 | The catalog product code of the catalog to be upgraded. This product code should be already declared  in 'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table. |
| PROD_VERSION          | VARCHA R2     |                10 | The catalog product version. It should be already declared in 'CATALOGUE_PRODUCT' table.                                            |
| 5 USER_CREATE         | VARCHA R2     |                15 | ID of the user when record created.                                                                                                 |
| 6 DATE_CREATE         | DATE          |                 7 | Record creation date and time.                                                                                                      |

|   7 | USER_MODIF   | VARCHA R2   |   15 | ID of the last user who modified the record.              |
|-----|--------------|-------------|------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|   8 | DATE_MODIF   | DATE        |    7 | Date and time when the last record modification occurred. |
